units.source_text: 乳母又找个机会向朱雀院奏道：“前日已将尊意示知左中弁。

en.t: The nurse found another opportunity to report to Suzaku-in, "The other day I conveyed Your Reverence's wishes to the Middle Counselor of the Left.

units.source_text: 他说：‘六条院主人一定接受。

en.t: He said, 'The master of Rokujo-in will certainly accept.

units.source_text: 多年以来，他常想迎娶一位正夫人，如此便可如愿以偿了。

en.t: For many years he has wished to take a lawful principal wife, and this would fulfill that desire.

units.source_text: 只要这边真心许可，我就向那边传达。’

en.t: If this side gives sincere permission, I will convey it to him.'

units.source_text: 此事毕竟如何，还请做主。

en.t: As for how this matter should finally be handled, I ask you to decide.

units.source_text: 六条院内有许多夫人，六条院大人对她们都很关怀，按照各人身份而予以优待。

en.t: There are many ladies in Rokujo-in, and Lord Rokujo cares deeply for them all, treating each according to her rank.

units.source_text: 但照普通臣民之家看来，夫人与许多姬妾相对立，总是缺憾之事。

en.t: But as ordinary subjects' households would see it, a principal wife standing alongside many consorts is always a regrettable situation.

units.source_text: 我家三公主倘入六条院，深恐亦将遭受意外之烦恼。

en.t: If our Third Princess enters Rokujo-in, I greatly fear she too will suffer unexpected troubles.

units.source_text: 希望娶得三公主者，不乏其人，还请上皇从长计议为是。

en.t: There is no shortage of men who wish to marry the Third Princess, so I hope Your Retired Majesty will consider the matter carefully over time.

units.source_text: 今世风习，无论身份何等高贵之公主，亦有爱好独立自主、随心所欲地度送独身生活的人。

en.t: In today's customs, even princesses of the highest rank sometimes prefer to live independently and spend their unmarried lives as they please.

units.source_text: 但我家三公主娇憨成习，稚气难除，不宜于独身生活。

en.t: But our Third Princess has grown accustomed to childish innocence and cannot shed her immaturity; she is not suited to an unmarried life.

units.source_text: 我等伺候之人，能力自有限度。

en.t: We who serve her naturally have limited abilities.

units.source_text: 即使是贤能的侍女，也只有依照主人吩咐而服务，即为尽职。

en.t: Even a capable gentlewoman fulfills her duty simply by serving according to her mistress's commands.

units.source_text: 因此三公主若无夫婿照顾，实甚可虑。”

en.t: Therefore, if the Third Princess has no husband to look after her, it is truly a grave concern."

units.source_text: 朱雀院答道：“是呀，我也有这感想。

en.t: Suzaku-in replied, "Yes, I feel the same way.

units.source_text: 公主下嫁，向来视为轻率之行。

en.t: For a princess to marry below her rank has always been regarded as a rash act.

units.source_text: 再者，即使身份高贵，凡女子有了丈夫，自然难免发生后悔之感与不快之事，甚至陷于悲伤苦闷之境。

en.t: Moreover, however noble her rank, once a woman has a husband she naturally cannot avoid regrets and unpleasant matters, and may even fall into sorrow and anguish.

units.source_text: 如果不嫁，于父母双亡、失却荫庇之后，抱定主意，独身度世，则又非长策。

en.t: Yet if she does not marry, and after both parents die and their protection is lost she resolves to pass through life alone, that is no lasting plan either.

units.source_text: 因为在古代，人心正直，世风敦厚，无人敢冒人世之大不韪而思娶神圣之公主。

en.t: In ancient times, people's hearts were upright and social customs were honest, and no one dared commit such a grave offense as to think of marrying a sacred princess.

units.source_text: 但今世人心不古，纵情好色，悖乱之事，时有所闻。

en.t: But in this age people's hearts are no longer as they were; they indulge in lust, and one often hears of disorderly scandals.

units.source_text: 昨日还是高贵之家父母所珍爱的金枝玉叶，今日即为卑不足道的轻薄男子所欺骗，以致声名堕地，使亡亲面目无光，含羞地下。

en.t: A treasured daughter of a noble house, cherished by her parents only yesterday, may today be deceived by a low and worthless libertine, ruining her reputation and shaming her dead parents in the grave.

units.source_text: 此种事例，不胜枚举。

en.t: Examples of this kind are too numerous to count.

units.source_text: 如此看来，不论下嫁或独身，一样深可担心。

en.t: Seen in this light, whether she marries below her rank or remains single, both are equally worrisome.

units.source_text: 凡人皆因前世宿缘而得今生果报，此中消息，我等不得而知，因此万事都可担心。

en.t: All people receive the consequences of this life according to bonds from former lives; we cannot know the workings of such things, and so everything gives cause for concern.

units.source_text: 不管好坏，一切依照父兄之命而行，听凭各人前世宿缘而定，则即使晚年生涯衰落，亦非本人之过失。

en.t: Whether the outcome is good or bad, if everything is done according to the commands of father and elder brothers and left to each person's former-life bonds, then even if her later years decline, it is not her own fault.

units.source_text: 反之，女子自择夫婿，长年相处，幸福无量，世间声望，亦甚美满。

en.t: On the other hand, if a woman chooses her own husband and lives with him for many years in boundless happiness, her reputation in the world is also quite splendid.

units.source_text: 当此之时，似觉自择夫婿亦颇不恶。

en.t: At such times, choosing one's own husband may seem not at all bad.

units.source_text: 但在当初骤传此消息时，父母皆不得知，亲友并未赞许，

en.t: But when the news first suddenly spreads, the parents know nothing of it and the relatives have given no approval,

units.source_text: 自作自主，私订终身，在女子实为最大之瑕疵。

en.t: and for a woman to act on her own and privately pledge her life is truly the greatest blemish.

units.source_text: 此种行为，即在寻常百姓之家，亦被视为轻狂浮薄之举。

en.t: Such behavior, even in an ordinary commoner's household, is regarded as frivolous and thoughtless.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，婚姻之事，毕竟不可不顾本人的意愿。

en.t: Even so, in matters of marriage one cannot, after all, ignore the person's own wishes.

units.source_text: 但倘为外力所迫，偶尔失身于不淑之人，就此决定了一生命运，便可想见此女子必然意志薄弱，态度轻率。

en.t: But if she is forced by outside pressure and by chance gives herself to an unworthy man, thereby deciding the fate of her whole life, one can see that such a woman must be weak-willed and rash.

units.source_text: 我看三公主异常幼稚，自己全无主见。

en.t: To my eyes, the Third Princess is exceedingly childish and has no opinions of her own at all.

units.source_text: 故你等当保姆者，切不可自作自主，代她择婿！

en.t: Therefore you attendants who care for her must never take matters into your own hands and choose a husband for her!

units.source_text: 倘有此种事情谣传于世，真乃不幸之极了！”

en.t: If rumors of such a thing were to spread through the world, it would truly be the height of misfortune!"

units.source_text: 朱雀院担心出家以后之事，故谆谆叮嘱。

en.t: Suzaku-in was worried about what would happen after he entered religion, and so he earnestly admonished them again and again.

units.source_text: 乳母等便觉今后责任更加重大，大家不胜惶恐。

en.t: The nurse and the others then felt that their responsibility from now on was even heavier, and they were all filled with awe and anxiety.
